rival_reading: A farm gate can close after routine deliveries, and a key-return tally may be ordinary property control rather than evidence of a failed emergency restriction.
gloss: A route record and returned key preserve conflicting times for access.
title: Key returned after access was withdrawn
body: The field gate's access line is crossed out before the final route time. A child's drawing is tied to the key; the only completed count records returned keys, not workers.

rival_reading: An emergency crew could record field supplies after a diversion; a blank source entry and a return signature do not establish a program malfunction.
gloss: A field measurement and a return record remain together with ordinary work items.
title: Field total entered before source
body: The water total is entered beside two field rows before the source box is completed. A lunch wrapper is folded in the clipboard; the only signed line confirms the bottle was returned.
